parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the feature configuration. For more information about how to query and use a ConfigId, see [Usage of ConfigId](~~388994~~).

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time.

parameters.name: FunctionNames
parameters.description: The names of the features. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For more information about feature names, see [Parameters for domain name configurations](~~388460~~).
